description: One peg, pale in the old wood

participation.context: Held the work, chose the pale peg over a chair that could not move, and kept the appointment.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the weak joint, drove the method, and stopped the mend short of a weight Sam could not carry.
participation.name: James Burbage

participation.context: Wrote the property line, including Master Kemp.
participation.name: Humphrey Larkham

participation.context: Offered a cure that only works if the chair stays put.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

participation.context: mentioned in One peg, pale in the old wood
participation.name: Will Kemp

relations.note: barred from the mended chair on the list
relations.quote: not to be sat on by Master Kemp.

story.body: You turned the chair up and drove one new peg into the weak joint. James kept the mend light enough to carry off. Sam's cure was refused because the chair has to leave the stage. Larkham wrote Kemp off the seat. You did not open the trap, and you left in time to be home by eleven.

relations.note: barred from the mended chair on the list
relations.quote: not to be sat on by Master Kemp.

title: Mended the chair of state with one pale peg

participation.context: Out of the frame, on the way home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You left the chair upside down on the trestles, the new peg pale in the old dark wood, and went to be home by eleven.

title: Left the chair upside down with the new peg pale
